credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Horizontal watercolor of a pinkish-orange female nude figure.  She is seated on the floor, twisting slightly forward with knees out to the left.  The figure is propped on one arm while the other floats upward.  No preliminary drawing, and no background color.  Nude Series XII. Possibly Self-Portraits etc. as noted in #176.
